scRhythmBayes phase palette

Source: R/plot_theme.R
palette_srb_phase.Rd

This function returns a soft circadian color palette for Zeitgeber time groups. The default palette is anchored to the six common sampling times ZT02, ZT06, ZT10, ZT14, ZT18, and ZT22, and interpolated to 24 integer hours.

Usage

palette_srb_phase(zt = NULL, matched = TRUE, names_as = c("key", "label"))

Arguments

zt

A numeric vector of Zeitgeber time values. If NULL, colors for integer hours 0 to 23 are returned. Defaults to NULL.

matched

Logical; if TRUE, colors are matched to zt. If FALSE, the full 24-hour palette is returned. Defaults to TRUE.

names_as

A character vector specifying the name format of returned colors. Must be one of "key" or "label". "key" uses numeric hour names such as "2"; "label" uses names such as "ZT02". Defaults to "key".

Value

A named character vector of colors.

Examples

palette_srb_phase()
#>         0         1         2         3         4         5         6         7 
#> "#D97B93" "#DE7E8A" "#E48282" "#EA867A" "#F08A72" "#F09470" "#F19E6E" "#F2A86C" 
#>         8         9        10        11        12        13        14        15 
#> "#F3B36A" "#E0BA6E" "#CEC272" "#BBC976" "#A9D17A" "#9ECD84" "#94CA8F" "#89C79A" 
#>        16        17        18        19        20        21        22        23 
#> "#7FC4A5" "#7EB1AB" "#7E9EB2" "#7E8BB8" "#7E79BF" "#9479B3" "#AB79A9" "#C27A9E" 
palette_srb_phase(c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22))
#>         2         6        10        14        18        22 
#> "#E48282" "#F19E6E" "#CEC272" "#94CA8F" "#7E9EB2" "#AB79A9"
